headline: 热点函数才值得改写成 Rust，fast-anything 让编程代理只动 README 所称最慢的那 5%，再对照录得的真实调用做验收。
headlineEn: Skip a full Rust rewrite: fast-anything profiles Python, Node, or Ruby, has a coding agent port only the hot path, and checks it against recorded calls.

lead.name: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
lead.zh: 剖析 Python、Node 或 Ruby 应用，让编程代理只把热点函数改写成 Rust，并对照录得的真实调用核对结果。
lead.en: Profile a Python, Node, or Ruby app, have a coding agent port only the hot functions to Rust, then check results against recorded real calls.
lead.why: 读者已在用编程代理改仓库。README 称多数耗时集中在少数函数，整仓重写代价高；它把代理用在可逆的局部移植和对照验收上。
lead.whyEn: Readers already point coding agents at repos. The README says most time sits in a few functions, so a full rewrite is costly; this keeps the agent on a reversible, checked local port.

sections.title: 免费 runner 上的真机代理测试，以及通宵任务
sections.titleEn: Device-farm agents on free runners, and overnight jobs

items.name: pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers
items.zh: 二十个 Claude Code 代理在 GitHub 免费 runner 上并行进不同模拟器，查找流程、翻译和布局问题。
items.en: Twenty Claude Code testers run at once on free GitHub runners, each driving a different phone image to catch broken flows, copy, and layout.

items.name: Plango
items.zh: 官方称可让 AI 代理通宵干活，并强调这样做是安全的。
items.en: The listing says your AI agents can keep going overnight, with safety as the stated constraint.

items.name: Replit Missions
items.zh: 按介绍先设定预算，再协调多组 AI 代理一起工作。
items.en: You set a spend cap first, then coordinate groups of AI agents from there.

sections.title: 像素叠图、反平均创意，以及把好会话写成技能
sections.titleEn: Sprite stacks, less-average ideas, and skills distilled from sessions

items.name: danielwh2/sprite-stacking
items.zh: 把四视图像素画叠成可旋转的伪三维精灵，可装进多种编程代理。
items.en: A skill that stacks four pixel-art views into a turntable sprite, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar CLIs.

items.name: mankidev/antialgorithm
items.zh: 创意任务里先点出模型最常给的平均答案，再按项目理由推开它。
items.en: For names, posters, and UI, it makes the model name its first generic pick, then leave it for a reason taken from the project.

items.name: sybil-solutions/skill-distill
items.zh: 会话结束后把好的 Claude Code 或 Codex 过程蒸馏成技能，交给开源权重模型复做。
items.en: After Claude Code or Codex does a task well, turn that session into a skill a smaller open-weight model can follow.

items.name: JimLiu/open-artifact
items.zh: 本地保存普通文件形式的产物，幻灯片、界面和表格可编辑、批注和导出。
items.en: Agent-agnostic artifacts stored as plain local files, so slides, UI, and sheets can be edited, commented on, and exported.

sections.title: 旧安卓当控制台、Mac 上的 Git 客户端，以及手摆的家庭实验室图
sections.titleEn: A spare Android desk deck, a Mac Git client, and a hand-placed homelab map

items.name: ersinkoc/phonebox
items.zh: 闲置安卓机可当电脑桌面触控板，USB 或配对 Wi-Fi，README 称不经过云。
items.en: Turn an old Android phone into a desk-side touch panel for Windows, Linux, or macOS over USB or paired Wi-Fi, with no cloud account.

items.name: Branchery
items.zh: 面向 Mac 用户的 Git 客户端。
items.en: A Git client for Mac, which is all the listing states.

items.name: Goblinmine/homelab-diagram
items.zh: 作者称从 YAML 清单渲染 r/homelab 风格图，布局是手摆的，代码与 Claude 一起写。
items.en: Renders an r/homelab-style map from a YAML inventory; the author says the layout is hand-placed and the code was written with Claude.
